title: New Job, New Rules
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。这是一个模拟的英语学习材料，不是官方雅思考试。请先通读全文，再完成8个题目。填空题的答案必须来自原文，且不超过字数限制。语法部分先看中文讲解，再完成8个新句子练习。
passage:
A
Lin Wei starts a new job at a small office in Shanghai. It is her first day. Her manager, Mr. Chen, shows her the desk. He explains the rules: "You have to arrive at 9 a.m. You must wear your ID card. You can take a short break at 3 p.m." Lin Wei listens carefully and writes notes so she can remember everything.

B
On Tuesday, Lin Wei makes a mistake. She forgets to sign a form. Mr. Chen says, "You have to sign every form. You must check the date, too." Lin Wei feels bad. She says, "I'm sorry. I can fix it now." She signs the form and checks the date. Mr. Chen smiles. "Good. You can ask me questions anytime."

C
On Friday, Lin Wei finishes her first week. She has to send a report to Mr. Chen. She must finish it before 5 p.m. She can use the computer in the meeting room. At 4:30, she sends the report. Mr. Chen says, "Great job. Next week, you can join the team meeting." Lin Wei is happy. She likes her new job and her friendly manager.

grammar.title: have to / must / can 与一般现在时和一般过去时
grammar.explanation: 在英语中，have to 和 must 都表示“必须、不得不”，但 have to 更强调客观规定，must 更强调说话人的要求。can 表示“可以、能够”。一般现在时表示经常发生或现在的事实，一般过去时表示过去发生的事。例如：She has to arrive at 9 a.m.（她必须9点到。）She forgot to sign a form.（她忘了签名。）注意：have to 在第三人称单数用 has to；must 后直接跟动词原形，不加 to；can 的过去式是 could。
grammar.example: You have to arrive at 9 a.m. You must wear your ID card. You can take a short break at 3 p.m.

questions.prompt: Tom ______ wear a uniform at work every day.
questions.explanation: 主语Tom是第三人称单数，所以用has to。

questions.explanation: Yesterday表示过去，所以用过去式made。
questions.evidence: On Tuesday, Lin Wei makes a mistake.

questions.evidence: She has to send a report to Mr. Chen.

questions.prompt: Last week, Ben ______ join the team meeting.
questions.explanation: Last week表示过去，can的过去式是could。
questions.evidence: Next week, you can join the team meeting.

questions.explanation: must后直接跟动词原形，不加to。
questions.evidence: You must check the date, too.

questions.prompt: They ______ arrive at 9 a.m. every day.
questions.evidence: You have to arrive at 9 a.m.
